celeste: Quick kickoff 10 14 for marketplace onboarding across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal this sprint: finalize SKU convention, trial copy for offers, and a minimal telemetry contract so finance can reconcile meters. I uploaded a short checklist: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/onboard-mini

samar: Proposal for SKU pattern: `redwood-<cloud>-<product>-<tier>-<region>-<flag>` (flag optional, e.g., `trial`). Example: `redwood-azure-inference-pro-europe-nl-trial`. Keeps parsing deterministic for our billing scripts.

elaine-legal: Note: Azure and private offers insist on explicit trial duration and renew behavior in the listing metadata. If you keep "trial" in SKU, include `trial_length_days` and `auto_renew: false|true` in the offer payload and an EULA anchor + DPA link. I can draft required snippets once SKU table is posted.

hiro-eng: Telemetry contract (short): emit event `marketplace.purchase.succeeded` with keys: sku, offer_id, plan, customer_id_hash, cloud, region, meter_code. Meter codes should be cloud-agnostic: RW_TOKENS, RW_EMB, RW_SESSIONS. Add `X-Redwood-Trace` header for correlation. We'll publish a JSON schema in the doc.

mike-ops: I'll spin up a sandbox publisher account in staging and grant samar + hiro access. Azure requires a SPN with MarketplacePublisher role; AWS needs SellerId metadata for private offers. I'll paste creds to the onboarding doc when ready.

ci-bot: pipeline queued: marketplace/sandbox-setup -> staging at 2024-11-13T01:30:00Z.

celeste: Owners: Samar -> SKU table + sample CSV, Hiro -> telemetry schema + smoke tests, Elaine -> EULA/DPA snippets, Mike -> sandbox creds + test offers. Target a canary in staging next Tue. I'll update the doc with owners now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
